Riding Lab · Draft for coach review

Advanced Performance Curriculum

Mathlete’s riding curriculum for advanced riders, racers and freestyle athletes. Every lesson here is a draft waiting for review by a qualified coach. 12 are written in full, and 20 are outlines that still need an author.

  • 11 ready for review
  • 1 need a specialist
  • 20 outlines
  • 0 approved

Risk classes

Class 1: performance foundations
Theory, analysis and planning. Practice still depends on terrain and context.
Class 2: advanced riding skills
Needs the stated prerequisites, a controlled progression, suitable terrain and coaching guidance.
Class 3: high-consequence skills
Theory and expert references only. Any practical progression is authored and supervised in person by a verified specialist coach, in a suitable facility.

Performance Foundations

The movement skills elite riders keep refining: position, pressure and vision, taught as tools that change with the terrain rather than poses to hold.
